6.354 rsPreviousAggregateInJoinExpression
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsPreviousAggregateInJoinExpression is a critical error that will occur when JoinCondition.ForeignKey
or JoinCondition.PrimaryKey contains a reference to the Previous aggregate function.
